A '''wrist blaster''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that was worn and fired from the wrist.

==Description==
There were two types of wrist blasters. One type was worn on the wrist by [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Due to its inconspicuousness, it was popular with [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], diplomats working in hostile territories, and other [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] who hated being completely unarmed. This wrist blaster was worn as a bracelet and looked like an ordinary piece of jewelry. The bulk of the wrist blaster contained the [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]], which was powerful enough to deliver the same damage as a blaster, but contained enough energy for only a single shot. Special alloys masked the wrist blaster from sensors that scan for weapons. Owning this type of weapon was illegal in all but specific, highly regulated circumstances.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" /> Variants of this type of wrist blaster included the [[wrist laser]] such as the [[Dur-24 wrist laser/Legends|Dur-24 wrist laser]] worn by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] had a wrist-mounted combination [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and wrist [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

The second and more powerful type of wrist blaster was mounted on [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] such as the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]. It had all the capabilities and firepower of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Other battle droids with similar wrist blasters included the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droid]], the [[A-series assassin droid]], the [[B1-A air battle droid]],<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[B2-AA air assault super battle droid|B2-AA Air Assault Super Battle Droid]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], bounty hunter [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] used a wrist blaster.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> Another known user was [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihl]], who used it in conjunction with his [[long-handle lightsaber]], making him a deadly foe.

==Behind the scenes==
B2 super battle droids with wrist blasters appeared in [[2002]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. In the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', wrist blasters are the B2's primary weapon. Other wrist blasters appeared in the comics ''[[The Weapons Master!]]'' and [[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]].
